summary_en: This Phase 1 study tests CD19-directed CAR-T cell therapy, called IC19/1563, in adults with relapsed or refractory B cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, or small lymphocytic lymphoma. Before the cell infusion, patients receive chemotherapy through a vein: cyclophosphamide and fludarabine on days -5 to -3, or bendamustine on days -4 and -3, followed by IC19/1563 on day 0. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a Phase 1 dose escalation trial.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1 evalúa la terapia con células CAR-T dirigidas a CD19, llamada IC19/1563, en adultos con linfoma de células B no Hodgkin, leucemia linfocítica crónica o linfoma linfocítico pequeño recidivante o refractario. Antes de la infusión de células, los pacientes reciben quimioterapia por vía intravenosa: ciclofosfamida y fludarabina en los días -5 a -3, o bendamustina en los días -4 y -3, seguidas de IC19/1563 el día 0. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; se trata de un estudio de fase 1 de escalada de dosis.
who_for: Relapsed or refractory CD19-positive B cell lymphoma, CLL, SLL, or Richter transformation of CLL.
Prior lines of therapy required, including an anthracycline-containing regimen for most lymphoma patients.
At least one measurable lesion larger than 1.5 cm on CT portion of PET/CT.
not_for: Pregnant or nursing persons, or women of childbearing potential unwilling to use highly effective contraception.
Patients able to obtain a market-approved CD19 CAR T-cell therapy.
History of seizure disorder, stroke-like cerebrovascular event, dementia, or cerebellar disease.
Current need for systemic steroids above 20 mg/day prednisone or equivalent.
Clinically significant active infection, or IV antibiotics within 7 days before registration.
